lumbre:
--- a/srv/edge/conf.d/admin-lumbre-pro.caddy
+++ b/srv/edge/conf.d/admin-lumbre-pro.caddy
@@ -14,6 +14,12 @@
 # backups de PocketBase, que tardan más que el timeout por defecto).
 admin.lumbre.pro {
 	encode zstd gzip
+	@pocketbasePanel path /_ /_/*
+	respond @pocketbasePanel 404
+	@vegaSpa {
+		not path /api/* /_ /_/*
+	}
+	header @vegaSpa Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src-attr 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https:; frame-src 'self' https:; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'"
 
 	request_body {
 		max_size 25MB
@@ -27,6 +33,8 @@
 	}
 
 	header {
+		X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
+		Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
 		Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
 		# Es un panel de administración: nada que indexar.
 		X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow, noarchive"
